# Newy Crete

> Newcastle concreting and earthmoving business trading as Newy Crete, legal entity Newy Concrete Solutions Pty Ltd.

## Services
- Concrete driveways and entrances
- Concrete pathways and surrounds
- Shed slabs and extension floors
- Footings, piers and retaining walls
- Exposed aggregate, broomed, honed and plain finishes
- Site cuts, spoil removal and earthworks
- Residential and builder packages
- Budget slab estimator on the website

## Service area
Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland, Cessnock, Port Stephens, Singleton, Muswellbrook and the wider Hunter Region, NSW.

## Contact
- Phone: 0436 486 214
- Website: https://laydbackapps.com/sites/newy-crete/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/newy_crete/

## Slab estimator
Enter length, width, thickness and finish on the website for an indicative supply-and-finish range. It is a budget guide, not a quote; final pricing follows an on-site measure.

## Quote process
Call or send the enquiry form. Newy Crete arranges an on-site measure, discusses finish and site conditions, then provides a fixed written price before work starts.

## FAQs
- Areas: Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland, Cessnock, Port Stephens, Singleton, Muswellbrook and the Hunter.
- Scope: driveways, pathways, shed and extension slabs, footings, piers, retaining walls, exposed finishes and site earthworks.
- Builders: send drawings or a scope summary for pricing.
- Existing finishes: bring a photo and Newy Crete will recommend the closest practical match.
